description: KNa₂Ga₃(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.19 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.94 Å. There are three inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Ga-O bond lengths are 1.86 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.86 Å. In the third Ga site, Ga is bonded to four O atoms to form GaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.85 Å) and two longer (1.86 Å) Ga-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Ga, and one Si atom.
